Registry.Name: TcpipClientSupport
Registry.Recommendation: Enable TcpipClientSupport on source domain controllers that participate in SID history migration, then restart the domain controller.

Services.Name: RemoteRegistry
Services.Recommendation: Enable and start Remote Registry where ADMT agents or prerequisite checks require remote registry access.

Groups.Name: Pre-Windows 2000 Compatible Access
Groups.Recommendation: Validate ADMT migration account access according to the migration design. No default member is applied by this module.

ServiceAccounts.Name: Source ADMT service account
ServiceAccounts.Recommendation: Specify the source ADMT service account and required source-domain group memberships in a customer-specific config.

Trusts.Name: Source to target trust
Trusts.Recommendation: Specify the target domain DNS name and expected trust settings in a customer-specific config.

DnsResolution.Name: Resolve target domain
DnsResolution.Recommendation: Specify target-domain DNS names that must resolve from the source environment.

Groups.Name: Administrators
Groups.Recommendation: Validate the ADMT migration account has the delegated rights required by the migration design. No default member is applied by this module.

ServiceAccounts.Name: Target ADMT service account
ServiceAccounts.Recommendation: Specify the target ADMT service account and required target-domain group memberships in a customer-specific config.

Trusts.Name: Target to source trust
Trusts.Recommendation: Specify the source domain DNS name and expected trust settings in a customer-specific config.

DnsResolution.Name: Resolve source domain
DnsResolution.Recommendation: Specify source-domain DNS names that must resolve from the target environment.

PowerShellModules.Name: ActiveDirectory
PowerShellModules.Recommendation: Install RSAT Active Directory PowerShell tools before running AD preparation commands.

Domain.Recommendation: Confirm the forest and domain functional levels are supported by the selected ADMT version and migration design.
